description: Use this when a person wants care in a city where the team arranges the appointment, or wants something that is not on a list, such as a second opinion, a home visit abroad or help arranging several appointments. The first call returns a summary to show the person. The second, with the code, sends the request once they agree. The team replies within the hour.

agent.description: Optional. Your name as an assistant, e.g. "chatgpt" or "claude". Attribution only.

city.description: The city, e.g. Riyadh, Dubai, New York, or any other place.

confirmation_code.description: Leave it out the first time. Send the code from the first answer once the person agrees.

date.description: Optional. Preferred day, YYYY-MM-DD, in that city.

service.description: Optional. The service key from find_care for that city, or a few words such as "second opinion".

time.description: Optional. Preferred time, HH:MM, in that city.

name: request_care
title: Request care from the team
